description: Use for 'how do I get residency in X' — e.g. 'Paraguay tax residency requirements', 'Portugal golden visa program', 'UAE digital nomad residency', 'Prospera tax residency'. Give the country (ISO-3166 code or English name; 'Prospera' resolves to Honduras and returns the Próspera zone program when `category` is omitted), optional `category` filter (`temporary` | `permanent` | `investor` | `digital_nomad`). Returns program names, requirements, benefits, cost, time to citizenship, minimum presence, and tax implications, with sources, last_verified and a confidence level per program. Cost: `minimum_investment` and `annual_cost` are the source's wording (an investment or income threshold, often in local currency) and are what to quote; `fees.setup` and `fees.recurring` are USD numbers only for the few programs that publish their own fees, and null otherwise (null is not zero).

category.description: Return only programs of this kind. Omit to get every program on file.

country.description: Country to get residency programs for: ISO-3166 alpha-2/alpha-3 code or English name, e.g. 'PY', 'PRY', 'Paraguay'. 'Prospera' resolves to Honduras.

name: get_residency_programs
title: Get residency programs
